digest.component_or_area: LLM Bedrock region configuration and provenance
propositions: region_source label must record whether bedrock_region_name was resolved from repo config file, CLI flag, or environment variable, rather than always labeling as REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION
LLMConfig.from_env collapses CLI/env/config-file resolution into a single string via _llm_str, losing origin metadata; a source-returning variant must capture and carry the origin
Resolution precedence must remain unchanged (CLI > REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION > config file > AWS_DEFAULT_REGION > AWS_REGION) while adding accurate provenance labels

bedrock_region_source must be threaded through runner.py and provenance_for so that the label reflects the same resolution pass that produced the value, preventing divergence between record and runtime

Config-file regions must be labeled region_source='repo-config' in provider provenance, CLI regions as 'cli', and env vars retain existing labels (REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION, AWS_DEFAULT_REGION, AWS_REGION)
